summary: Bain Capital Private Credit, a non-traded BDC, filed an 8-K reporting a routine unregistered sale of 192,455 Class I common shares to feeder vehicles at the August 31, 2026 NAV of $25.98 per share, for $5.0 million consideration, finalized September 25, 2026, under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S. The filing also disclosed a regular monthly distribution of $0.1875 and a special distribution of $0.0300 per share, and portfolio NAV of $1,153.6 million with 1.17x debt-to-equity. As an ordinary private placement and distribution notice, it does not constitute a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle apply.
